guard.scope: Document-reload first-ready guard, not direct cold-process startup gain

limitations: One-trial report verdicts are not acceptance.
New isolated environment confounds historical causal comparisons.
Actual installed hash captured immediately before each tool; legacy guard trace itself has no APK hash.
Both emulators share host resources; no claim of host CPU isolation.
